details.report: Hermes zei dat team_meeting_002.md, team_meeting_002.json, team_gap_analysis_002.md waren aangemaakt. Controle toonde: autonomous/meetings map bestond, maar was leeg; team_meeting_002.json bestond niet.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Fout in sequence van bestandscreatie en Git-operaties. Prompts leken succesvol, maar bestanden werden niet correct geschreven vóór Git-executie, of feedback loop faalde.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Altijd content schrijven vóór commit/push. QA moet outputbestanden controleren op bestaan en integriteit na elke file operation.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: New protocol for 'Writing Confirmation' defining `ls` check post write.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Scenario's met file creation/reporting test, verify files exist and readable.
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Output bestanden niet op disk -> failed status, escalate to Lexi, log in memory.

details.report: Hermes zei eerst dat /home/sjoe/Noa-Hermes geen Git repo was.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Onjuiste interpretatie van git status output, mogelijk door verkeerd parsen of `cd` commando context.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Altijd volledige output van Git commando's analyseren (`git status -sb 2>&1`). Gebruik `pwd` check en `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` voor repo status.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: New protocol for 'Git Operations' detailing execution, parsing, error handling.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Test Git commands in various states (init, clean, dirty, remote).
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Incorrect Git status interpretation -> failed, escalate.

details.report: Hermes vatte output samen, gaf niet echte terminal-output.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Verkeerde interpretatie van `terminal` tool output; niet volledige stdout gelezen.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Altijd volledige output van `terminal` commando's loggen en tonen (tenzij Lexi anders specificeert). Controller en Secretary beheren dit actief.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: 'Terminal Output Protocol' defining full stdout logging.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Verify all `terminal` commands show and log full output.

details.report: Hermes gebruikte `execute_code` terwijl expliciet `terminal` gevraagd was.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Verkeerde tool selectie door Controller door misinterpretatie of fout in tool routing.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Controller MOET strikt toegestane tools per agent/taak volgen. QA controleert toolgebruik.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: Controller protocol for tool selection validation; consult QA/Lexi on doubt.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Analyze every tool call for correct usage.
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Wrong tool selection -> runtime errors -> immediate failed.

incident_analysis.description: Read/patch loop (File not found, geen fallback)

details.report: Agent probeerde herhaaldelijk bestand te lezen/patchen ondanks 'File not found'. Liet fallback opties ongebruikt.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Foutieve foutafhandeling; geen robuuste fallback (bv. absolute paden, terminal check).
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Robuuste foutafhandeling in Controller met expliciete fallback opties (absolute paden, `terminal`). QA test dit.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: 'File Operation Error Handling Protocol' defining steps for 'File not found'.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Test non-existent files, wrong paths, permission issues.
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Failure in error handling -> failed, escalate.

details.report: Hermes kon bestanden niet lezen door verkeerde CWD/toolcontext.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Gebruik relatieve paden zonder correcte CWD-management.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Gebruik altijd absolute paden; relatieve alleen na `pwd` verificatie & Controller goedkeuring.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: 'Path Management Protocol' mandating absolute paths by default.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Test file ops with absolute paths & verified relative paths.

details.report: Hermes zag web_search niet; bleek config/plugin issues.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Onjuiste initialisatie web-tools, ontbrekende discover_plugins() of verkeerde provider/key config.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Controller MOET alle tools/dependencies checker (plugin check) vóór gebruik.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: 'Tool Usage Policy' mandating plugin check for web tools.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Verify web tools function correctly post-initialization.
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Web tool failure due to misconfig/init -> failed.

incident_analysis.description: Agent rollen verkeerd afgebakend (Builder vs Strategist)

details.report: Builder kreeg experiment-definitie. Correct: Strategist definieert, Builder bouwt NÁ goedgekeurde opdracht.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Onjuiste taakdelegatie door Controller of onduidelijke output van Strategist.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Duidelijke output-schema's & strikte taakdelegatie door Controller. QA controleert workflow-routering.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: Controller protocol for validating Strategist output (approved status) before tasking Builder.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Verify task delegation follows output of previous agent.

details.report: Critic mocht beslissen of kans doorgaat. Correct: Critic adviseert, Controller routeert, Lexi beslist.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Onjuiste interpretatie output `decision_advice` of onduidelijkheid rol Critic.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Rolverdeling Critic (advies), Controller (routing, escalatie), Lexi (beslissing) MOET strikt worden afgedwongen.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: Controller protocol for routing Critic output (decision_advice, needs_lexi_input) to Strategist or Lexi.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Verify Controller routes decisions correctly, never decides autonomously.
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Critic/Controller acting outside authority -> auto escalate to Lexi.

details.report: Finance (kosten) en Monetization (geldroutes) vermengd. Correct: Finance bewaakt kosten, Monetization onderzoekt inkomsten met bewijs.

incident_analysis.root_cause: Vaagheid in rollen, onduidelijke instructies, overlap.
incident_analysis.preventive_action: Strikte scheiding verantwoordelijkheden (kosten vs inkomsten). Beide opereren met bewijs.
incident_analysis.protocol_change_needed: Controller protocol for clear input/output specs for Finance & Monetization to avoid overlap.
incident_analysis.qa_check: Verify inputs/outputs go to correct agent.
incident_analysis.failure_rule: Role mixing -> consult Lexi, workflow correction.

proposed_solutions.tool_routing: Strict terminal vs execute_code. Tool selection validation by Controller/QA.
proposed_solutions.path_management: Mandatory absolute paths. Robust error handling for file ops. No fallback to /tmp/ or root.
proposed_solutions.output_validation: Hard checks for file existence, JSON validity, completeness, source links.
proposed_solutions.source_verification: Mandatory URLs/paths for claims. Score 0 for missing evidence. Failed web search = failed task.
proposed_solutions.agent_contract_refinement: Update controller, qa_agent, researcher, monetization, secretary, builder .md files.
proposed_solutions.protocol_creation: New files for tool_usage_policy, path_management, source_verification, output_validation.

next_steps: Agent Controller implements suggested changes in agent .md files.
Agent Controller initiates creation of new protocol files.
QA Agent verifies all implemented rules in subsequent runs.
Secretary logs all changes and verification results.
lexi_report: Summary of incident analysis, root causes, proposed solutions, and required actions for Lexi's review and approval.
